task: Show me recipes for pancakes with wheat and without beetroot.
agent_final_answer:
Here are recipes for pancakes with wheat and without beetroot found on Cookpad:

1. Whole wheat pancakes
- URL: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/16356152
- Key Ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup toasted wheat germ, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 large eggs lightly beaten, 3 cups buttermilk, 1 tablespoon canola oil. (No beetroot)

2. Waffle and pancake recipe
- URL: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/25447752
- Key Ingredients: 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1/2 cup coconut flour, 2 eggs, vanilla, cinnamon powder, 1 tbsp coconut oil, 1/4 cup milk, water, salt, 1 tbsp date sauce. (No beetroot)

3. Cottage Cheese Pancakes
- URL: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/24475225
- Key Ingredients: 200 g whole-wheat flour (or 250 g all-purpose flour), 250 g cottage cheese, 4 eggs, 15 g baking powder, 30 g granulated sugar, 5 g salt, 5 ml vanilla, 50 ml bubbling water (optional), butter/vegetable oil for frying. (No beetroot)

4. Hibiscus pancakes 🥞
- URL: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/25038175
- Key Ingredients: 2 cups flour of choice (uses wheat), 1 1/2 - 2 cups zobo (hibiscus) juice, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/4 - 1/2 cup brown sugar, 2 eggs, 1/4 cup tamarind paste, 1/4 cup Greek yogurt, 1/4 tsp salt. (No beetroot)

5. California Farm Lent Pancakes
- URL: https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/16833341
- Key Ingredients: 1 cup spelt wheat or whole wheat, 1 cup buckwheat, 2 cups whole milk, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sea salt, 2 fresh farm eggs, 2 tbsp olive oil. (No beetroot)
